sources.location: deposited DIANN_results_BALF.zip and DIANN_results_Lung.zip Pass1/Pass2 logs (scratchpad/PXD029625/evidence/DIANN_*.txt)
RAW headers read by HTTP range request (instrument string; see scratchpad/PXD029625/evidence/raw_header_check.json)

claims.value: Lung and BALF × B (bleomycin + vehicle), BTH (bleomycin + TH5487), DEX (bleomycin + dexamethasone), TH (saline + TH5487), V (saline + vehicle); n = 4–5
claims.evidence: RAW names encode tissue, group, animal number; Methods define groups and doses (bleomycin 2.5 U/kg i.t., TH5487 40 mg/kg i.p., dexamethasone 10 mg/kg i.p.)

claims.value: DIA (44 variable windows), Q Exactive HF-X, stepped NCE 25.5/27/30
claims.evidence: sample protocol; RAW headers (PRIDE instrument field says Q Exactive HF)

limitations: Lung and BALF runs with the same group/number are not asserted to be the same animal (no deposited statement) → no individual column.
Age at sampling not given (10–12 weeks on arrival + ≥2 weeks + 21 days) → not annotated.
CAM is annotated fixed (DIA-NN --unimod4 semantics); the Methods sentence calls it 'variable'. DIA-NN auto-optimises tolerances → none annotated.
reconcile BLOCKER 'run names name lung but every row says BALF' and MAJOR 'control arm' are false positives of the single-value comparison: 22 rows are lung, 22 BALF, and saline groups are 'normal'.
